description: Run a JVM Kotlin project's wired static-analysis tools — detekt (Gradle `io.gitlab.arturbosch.detekt` 1.x / `dev.detekt` 2.x, or Maven `com.github.ozsie:detekt-maven-plugin`, or a project-provided detekt CLI) and ktlint (Gradle `org.jlleitschuh.gradle.ktlint` or Spotless `ktlint()`, Maven `com.github.gantsign.maven:ktlint-maven-plugin` or Spotless) — on Maven or Gradle (Kotlin DSL or Groovy, wrapper preferred), multi-module aware, then read the generated reports (detekt Checkstyle-format XML or SARIF, ktlint checkstyle/plain reporter output, Spotless console output) to report every issue found (file, line, rule id, severity, message), grouped by tool. Covers plain Kotlin libraries, Kotlin Spring Boot, and Kotlin Quarkus — not Android (use `iru-android-code-quality`); Java sources in a mixed Java+Kotlin module are covered by `iru-java-code-quality`, not here. Invoke as `/iru-kotlin-code-quality` to check the whole project, or `/iru-kotlin-code-quality <path-or-class-name>` to scope the *reported* summary to a file/class/module — detekt/ktlint always analyze whole modules (no per-file selector), so a scoped invocation narrows the build to the owning module and filters the report. Report-only: verifies each tool is actually wired before trusting a "zero issues" result, reports an unwired tool as "not wired" instead of a clean pass, and never adds or changes detekt/ktlint/Spotless configuration. When the prompt supplies a baseline (per-tool/per-rule counts or an itemized list from an earlier run), reports only the new-vs-baseline diff. Use whenever the user wants a Kotlin lint/static-analysis pass called out separately from `iru-java-test`/`iru-java-coverage`, instead of eyeballing `./gradlew detekt` or `mvn verify` console output.
